body:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: Incident created — KV-cache cont-batching error-rate surge on qwen/mistral pool (us-west-2). Trigger: 5xx increase + KV eviction rate 10x. Pager sent to oncall-ryan.

oncall-ryan: I’m on it. seeing GQA and MQA tails spike, latency P99 -> ~2.8s, 5xx ~12% on qwen-v2. Starting investigating routes + batch config.

eng-runtime-alex: logs show continuous-batcher queueing huge prefixes, KV hit-rate drops, memory thrash. snippet: ```evict_count=13421 kv_mem_gb=78/80 contbatch_queue=2300```

eng-ml-sara: model-specific note — Qwen has long prefix contexts for some customers, MQA path is sensitive to large batch windows. suspecting batch_max_tokens growth + prefix caching misalignment.

oncall-ryan: Can we throttle batching at runtime? If we reduce batch window we can lower aggregation and KV pressure. Planning hotfix: set `batch_max_tokens=128` and `continuous_batch_window_ms=5` for problematic pool, and enable forced prefix-eviction for >4k tokens.

eng-runtime-alex: I can push a patch to the runtime config and apply to us-west-2 pool. Will stage to 2 nodes first. `kubectl set env ds/contbatch BATCH_MAX_TOKENS=128` — testing now.

platform-ops-miguel: FYI autoscaler is at 85% — if we throttle we might increase latency for some low-latency customers. We should route high-priority customers to dedicated pool while we fix.

customer-success-lina: flagging top affected tenants: AcmeChats (high traffic), LegalAssist (sensitive SLAs). Both saw error spikes. Reaching out to let them know we’re mitigating.

eng-sre-tess: handing off pager to me at +30m mark. Ryan — summarize current mitigations and state.

oncall-ryan: Handoff: applied staged config to 2 nodes, KV evict script invoked, observed immediate drop in contbatch_queue to ~400 on staged nodes. Rolling to remaining nodes if no regressions. Actions: config rollback ready, can route traffic to dedicated fallback models (qwen-lite) if errors persist.

eng-sre-tess: taking over. pushing full rollout to remaining nodes now. Will monitor 5xx and KV eviction rates.

incidents-bot: Deployment started by eng-runtime-alex — rollout id `roll-199456-01`. Progress: 2/10 nodes updated.

eng-runtime-alex: 6/10 nodes updated. contbatch_queue cluster avg down to 900, KV evict rate back to baseline after eviction job. Request latency trending down.

eng-ml-sara: Also toggled model variant fallback policy to prefer qwen-compact for requests >1k tokens for the next 2 hours. This should reduce MQA stress.

platform-ops-miguel: Routing rule applied: `route:if tenant in ["AcmeChats","LegalAssist"] -> dedicated-usw2` — customers being migrated.

customer-success-lina: Notifying AcmeChats: short message prepared: "We experienced elevated errors  — we’ve applied mitigations and routed your traffic to dedicated nodes; monitoring closely. Will update with RCA."

eng-sre-tess: After full rollout (10/10) we see 5xx drop to <1.5% and P99 back to ~1.1s. Marking incident as mitigated.

incidents-bot: Incident status changed to MITIGATED by eng-sre-tess.

oncall-ryan: Follow-ups: need postmortem to cover root cause and long-term fixes: 1) prevent cont-batch window growth for long-prefix tenants, 2) KV cache backpressure protection, 3) autoscale thresholds & routing hygiene.

eng-runtime-alex: Action items I’ll own: implement runtime guard `max_contbatch_queued_tokens` and a circuit-breaker to reject/route requests when KV eviction rate crosses threshold.

eng-ml-sara: I’ll own model-side mitigations: encode prefix-length heuristics for MQA/GQA, and add a regression test that simulates heavy long-prefix traffic.

platform-ops-miguel: Ops will add a runbook for emergency routing to dedicated pools and tune autoscaler to react faster to cont-batch pressure.

customer-success-lina: I’ll follow up with impacted customers and coordinate RCAs.

eng-sre-tess: Assigning postmortem owner: eng-runtime-alex. Draft due EOD +2 days. Tagging as sev-2 (customer impact but mitigated).

oncall-ryan: thumbs up. Closing handoff. If any regressions re-pager me. :white_check_mark:

incidents-bot: Incident closed (mitigated -> closed) after follow-ups assigned. Logs and timeline archived to #incidents/1994567890 for postmortem writeup.
